turns.scenarioTitle: Organize a project with messy, loose documents

judge.reasoning: The assistant read the content of all loose documents, created logical parent folders ('Notes & Brainstorms', 'Meetings', 'Pricing & Strategy', 'Outreach & Comms'), and moved each document appropriately while fully preserving all content.

persistence.note: Counts final retained chat-path rows and their serialized JSON size. It does not measure update frequency, WAL bytes, or concurrent database traffic.

limitations: The retained-row footprint is a final-state parity baseline, not a PostgreSQL WAL or statement-rate measurement.
Provider latency is included in end-to-end and first-response timing; later worker comparisons must separate BuildOS queue/transport overhead.
Prompt, message, tool-argument, tool-result, and event payload bodies are measured in memory for byte size but are not retained in this artifact.

Execution observations include only the database-enforced provider/tool metadata allowlist; prompt, argument, result, message, and hidden-reasoning content is excluded. When the worker rejected a streamed tool call, the rejected tool name and advertised tool count are retained — never the call arguments.
